text: AI is changing the way we think about creativity. Today, computers can create art, write stories, and even compose music. These tools learn from huge amounts of data and then produce something new. Some people are amazed by this, while others feel worried. Can a machine really be creative in the same way humans are? Human creativity comes from emotions, personal experiences, and imagination. AI, on the other hand, follows patterns and rules. Perhaps the best result is not a competition, but a partnership, where people and AI work together to make something truly original.
